fields.title: Programme Assistant
fields.body:
The Country Office in Nairobi seeks a Programme Assistant to support the humanitarian response portfolio.

Responsibilities include scheduling meetings, maintaining the activity tracker, and drafting routine correspondence.

Education: completed secondary education; a diploma in social sciences is desirable.

Experience: a minimum of one year of relevant experience is desirable. Recent graduates with strong organisational skills are encouraged to apply.

How to apply: submit your application through the recruitment portal linked on this page.

source.name: UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs

fields.title: Senior Finance Manager
fields.body:
Lead the finance function for a multi-country portfolio. Supervise a team of five, own donor reporting, and lead annual audits.

Experience: a minimum of eight years of progressive finance experience, including three years in a management role. CPA(K) required.

Apply via the portal by the closing date.
